summary: RazziaType's one-column specimen for RT Alias, a pixel type system (Grotesk, Fine, Medium, Rough × Light/Regular/Bold + obliques), all in phosphor green on black like a CRT. The pages are mostly pre-rendered diagram images (the grids, pixel sizes, stem widths, how a shoulder curve turns into steps), plus live style lists and retro-console names in each subfamily. Static, with three pill CTAs at the end.

instances.look: A green-on-green specimen sheet in four quadrants (GROTESK, FINE, MEDIUM, ROUGH): each a huge bright-green 'A' on metric guide lines, a vertical 'RT ALIAS' label, an outlined 'A' showing its pixel grid, a 3×2 key of small A's (Light/Regular/Bold, roman/oblique) and checkerboard swatches of the pixel size
instances.learn: Introduce a pixel system by putting the same letter in every subfamily side by side, each with its own grid: the range and the logic in one frame
